create_reader_ner_ontonotes: create a NerOntonotesReader instance to read NER annotations from CoNLL-formatted OntoNotes dataset files
read_ner_dataset: read NER instances from an OntoNotes dataset file path with optional domain filtering
convert_coding_scheme: convert IOB1 named entity tags to BIOUL coding scheme for sequence labeling
create_text_to_instance: create an AllenNLP Instance from a list of tokens and optional NER tags
filter_ontonotes_subset: iterate over OntoNotes sentences filtered by a specific domain identifier
